title: fix: one name per audio parameter
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- `duration` is the length parameter for all audio models, and `seconds` stays accepted as an alias
- Music, Lyria clip and Stable Audio models declare their durations in the registry, and `/audio/models` publishes them as `min_duration`/`max_duration`/`allowed_durations`; one check replaces the Lyria clip check
- Voice changer and voice isolator take the upload as `file`, like transcription and stem separation; `audio` still works
- Sound effects keep clamping `duration` to 0.5–30 s, as before

| Request | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Stable Audio, `duration: 350` | 400 (duration max 300) | 350 s |
| Music v2, `duration: 2` | sent upstream | 400 listing 3-300 |
| Lyria clip, `duration: 20` | 400 | 400, shared message |
| Voice changer upload | `audio` only | `file` or `audio` |

gist.headline: Audio gets one clock
gist.blurb: The audio API settles on `duration`, while `seconds` still answers to its old name. Uploads get a shared `file` parameter too; aliases remain welcome.
gist.summary: Audio models use `duration` with `seconds` as an alias, publish their duration limits through `/audio/models`, and accept `file` uploads for voice changing and isolation while retaining `audio` as an alias.
gist.impact: Stable Audio accepts a 350-second request, Music v2 rejects durations below its listed 3–300-second range, and voice changer and isolator accept the same `file` field as transcription.
